title: Laser Hair Removal for Dark Skin in Dubai
h1: Laser hair removal for dark skin: choosing the right laser
desc: Laser hair removal for darker skin tones in Dubai: which laser wavelengths are safest, how settings are adjusted, risks to avoid and how to prepare.
answer: Laser hair removal is safe and effective on darker skin when the laser and settings are matched to the skin type. Longer wavelengths such as diode (around 800 nm with longer pulses) and Nd:YAG (1064 nm) pass the skin's own pigment more safely and reach the follicle, while strong cooling protects the surface. At Skin & Laser the device and settings are chosen at your consultation, often after a test patch.
facts: IPL on dark or tanned skin
body:
## Why skin tone matters

Lasers target melanin, the pigment in hair. Darker skin also contains more melanin, so the wrong wavelength or setting can heat the skin instead of the follicle. That is what causes burns or patches of lighter or darker skin.

## How we keep darker skin safe

- Longer wavelengths that are absorbed less by the skin
- Longer pulse durations and lower energy per pulse
- Contact cooling before, during and after each pulse
- A test patch before the first full session when needed
- Strict sun avoidance before and after treatment

## Our technology

At Skin & Laser we use a [diode laser](/blog/diode-laser-hair-removal-dubai/) with long-pulse settings and [Smartitrion-Q](/blog/smartitrion-q-laser-dubai/), and your doctor chooses the device and settings for your skin type.

## What to expect

Results are just as good on darker skin, but progress can be a little more gradual because settings are more conservative. Most people need 8 or more sessions, with occasional top-ups.
faq: Is laser hair removal safe for very dark skin?
Yes, with the right wavelength and settings. Nd:YAG and long-pulse diode are commonly used for the darkest skin types.
Can laser cause dark marks on brown skin?
Temporary darkening can happen, mainly after sun exposure or too-high settings. Correct settings and sun protection keep the risk low.
Can I have laser if I'm tanned?
Wait until the tan fades. Tanned skin absorbs more laser energy and is more likely to react.
